`maxentcpp` provides a C++17 reimplementation of the [MaxEnt](https://biodiversityinformatics.amnh.org/open_source/maxent/) species-distribution-modeling algorithm (Phillips et al.), which is widely used to estimate species geographic distributions from occurrence records and environmental covariates. The original MaxEnt tool is written in Java; `maxentcpp` reproduces the algorithm in modern C++ and exposes it to R through Rcpp.

The package was developed by [Angel Robles Fernandez](../../../people.qmd#angel-robles). Moving the MaxEnt fit into a compiled C++ layer removes Java/R interop overhead. It is also usable as a standalone MaxEnt implementation from R.

- Package website: <https://alrobles.github.io/maxentcpp/>
- Source: <https://github.com/alrobles/maxentcpp>
- CRAN: <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/maxentcpp/maxentcpp.pdf>

People: [Angel Robles Fernandez](../../../people.qmd#angel-robles)
